mercedes-amg-g63.tagline: Three differential locks and a 585 hp biturbo V8 under a silhouette that hasn't changed since 1979.

lamborghini-urus.tagline: Five seats and 650 hp of biturbo V8 under matte black paintwork, with the yellow saved for the cabin.

audi-rs6-avant.tagline: Five seats, a full estate boot and a 600 hp biturbo V8 that settles 0-100 in 3.6 seconds.

porsche-911-cabrio.tagline: A 450 hp biturbo flat-six behind your shoulders and a roof that drops in twelve seconds on the move.

porsche-911-carrera-s.tagline: The last naturally aspirated Carrera S: a 3.8 flat-six that pulls to 7,400 rpm, seven-speed PDK and a sunroof.

porsche-cayenne-hybrid.tagline: Chalk grey outside, red leather inside: 470 hp that leaves the car park in electric silence and posts 4.9 seconds.

mercedes-amg-a45.tagline: A five-seat hatchback with its four-cylinder hand-built in Affalterbach: 421 hp and 3.9 seconds to 100 km/h.

audi-rs3-sportback.tagline: No other hatchback sounds like this inline five: 400 hp, a rear torque splitter and 3.8 seconds to 100.

audi-rsq3.tagline: Firing order 1-2-4-5-3: the 2.5 TFSI five-cylinder feeds 400 hp to the quattro system and posts 0-100 in 4.5 seconds.

volkswagen-golf-r.tagline: A five-seat hatchback hiding 420 Nm, high-performance brakes and a Race mode under plain black bodywork.

range-rover-velar.tagline: Flush handles, deep blue and caramel leather: the Velar D200 carries its 430 Nm across Barcelona without raising its voice.

mercedes-glc.tagline: AMG Line black over pale leather: 258 hp with 48-volt electric assistance and permanent 4MATIC drive.

mercedes-a200-4matic.tagline: The Mercedes hatchback with 163 mild-hybrid hp, a 7G-DCT dual-clutch gearbox and AMG Line trim in white.

lamborghini-huracan-evo-spyder.tagline: A naturally aspirated 640 hp V10 under a fabric roof that folds away in 17 seconds: matt military green outside, white seats inside.

lamborghini-urus-s.tagline: Gloss black outside and tobacco brown leather inside, the headlining trimmed in dark Alcantara and red calipers showing through the diamond-cut wheels.

aston-martin-dbx.tagline: Graphite grey paintwork, bronze wheels and pale leather inside: the DBX707 makes 707 hp, 0-100 km/h in 3.3 s and a 310 km/h top speed.

mercedes-amg-g63-verde-oliva.tagline: 585 hp from a twin-turbo V8, satin olive green outside and quilted red leather inside: 2.5 tonnes that go from 0 to 100 km/h in 4.5 s.

range-rover-sv.tagline: A 565 hp supercharged V8, black bodywork and an interior of pale diamond-quilted leather with black contrast, beneath a panoramic roof.

range-rover-vogue.tagline: Navy blue over two-tone ivory and blue leather, dark figured wood and a twin-panel panoramic roof: a 258 hp diesel with 600 Nm of steady pull.

mercedes-gls.tagline: Light grey with black wheels and black leather under blue ambient light: seven proper seats, with 367 hp and 750 Nm of torque to move them.

range-rover-sport-svr.tagline: Exposed carbon fibre bonnet, electric blue paint and white leather inside: 575 hp from the supercharged V8 and 4.5 s to 100 km/h.

mercedes-gle-coupe.tagline: White paint and tobacco brown leather, AMG Line package and a panoramic roof: the GLE 300 d makes 269 hp, with 4MATIC all-wheel drive and 0-100 km/h in 6.9 s.

range-rover-sport.tagline: Gloss black with darkened wheels and ivory leather inside: 340 hp from a supercharged V6 that moves it along without raising its voice.

mercedes-amg-glc-43.tagline: 421 hp with an electric turbocharger drawn from Formula 1, gloss black bodywork and black AMG seats with red stitching.

mercedes-clase-v.tagline: Black leather, four individual rear seats facing each other across a folding table and ambient lighting: the Mercedes lounge on wheels for travelling as a group.
highlights: Six seats, all of them individual chairs
Four facing seats with a folding table

mercedes-glc-coupe.tagline: Light grey with the Night Package, a panoramic roof and brown leather over black: coupé bodywork and permanent 4MATIC all-wheel drive.
highlights: Night Package: black exterior, brown leather
